content.text:
The script is `scripts/docs.py`, a Typer CLI. It contains:

- `build_lang`, `build_all`, `build_zensical_lang_to_stage`, `copy_zensical_stage_to_site`, etc. — commands that build the (Zensical-based) documentation site into `./site/`.
- `generate_readme` command (with helper `generate_readme_content`) — regenerates `README.md` from `docs/en/docs/index.md`, injecting the sponsors section and stripping mkdocs-only content/header permalinks.

So `scripts/docs.py` is the single script responsible for both building the docs site and regenerating the README.
